text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that fails the core inclusion criteria. Its primary focus is on quantifying the impacts of climate change and land-use change on water resources (hydrological fluxes) in the Upper Ganges river basin. While it uses 15 future land-use pathways as an input, the generation of these pathways is not the central research question; the study's objective is to assess hydrological change. Furthermore, the spatial implementation is explicitly at the basin scale (87,000 km² in northern India), not the national scale of India.)
